purpose_context: This mission establishes the independently releasable repository, version-pinned upstream payload, compatibility and lifecycle seams, private desktop transport, and identical Tauri and Electron vertical slices. It ends with a reproducible parity, memory, responsiveness, and startup decision rather than a framework-first commitment.
purpose_tldr: Deliver a standalone macOS desktop foundation that preserves the complete official DSH experience and selects the production shell through measured evidence.
